summary: Unlocks the wooden chest behind the Chromatic Scale counter.

fields.Lock: Wooden chest at X −176, Y −54, containing gold and alchemical ingredients. DC 15 Sleight of Hand without the key.
fields.Acquisition: The item page places a copy on the Chromatic Scale counter at X −172, Y −61. The location page also lists Thomas C. Quirkilious carrying the key.
fields.Separate lock: The Glitter Gala basement hatch uses Omotola’s keys.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
